ADMINISTRATIVE FEES 
1. Certificate of Occupancy (CO) where required: 
A. Buildings and structures regulated by the RCO - $58.44 ($61.94 with surcharge and technology fee included) 
B. Buildings and structures regulated by the OBC - $189.62 ($204.79 with surcharge and technology fee included) 
C. Certificate of Completion of Permit (CC) – for all permits where a CO is not required 
Residential - $32.46 ($34.4 with surcharge & technology fee included) 
Commercial - $32.46 ($35.05 with surcharge & technology fee included) 
2. Certificate of Temporary Occupancy (TCO): 
A. Buildings and structures regulated by the HCBC 
$148.05 - 1st 30 days + $76.63 each additional 30 days 
If additional TCO is required $296.08 – 1st co days + $148.05 each additional 30 days 
B. Buildings and structures regulated by the OBC 
$296.08 – 1st 30 days + $148.05 each additional 30 days 
If additional TCO is required $588.29 – 1st co days + $296.08 each additional 30 days 
C. Occupying w/o TCO, penalty fee 
Residential - $296.08 
Commercial - $588.29 to be paid in addition to TCO fee 
D. Occupying w/o a Certificate of Occupancy 
Residential - $296.08 
Commercial - $588.29 
3. Refund of Permit Fee (HC.A108.4). If granted, shall be in the amount of half the entire permit fee, after deducting the Up-Front Fee and the Zoning Certificate Fee. 
4. Time Extensions (Section HC.A105.6) each - $100 
5. Unspecified Permit Fee – for any permit type, not specifically listed in this Fee Schedule, the fee shall be calculated to the most similar permit type, use group and
type of construction to be determined at the discretion of the Building Official 
6. Scanning fee for Permit Applications reviewed under OBC for paper documents submitted without a digital copy in an approved format: 
Documents up to 8-1/2 X 14 (including Specs.) $2.68/side 
Documents larger than 8-1/2 X 14 (including Specs.) $7.82/side 
7. Field Inspection and Processing Fee (non-building permit related): 
Residential - $148.05 ($156.93 with surcharge & technology fee included) 
Commercial - $189.62 ($204.79 with surcharge & technology fee included) 
8. After Hours Inspection (OBC Permits) $180.51 per hour 
Minimum fee $722.04 to be paid at time of scheduling inspection + 3% $21.66 + 5% $36.1 =$779.8 
9. Plan Review Fee – Assessed at 3rd review for each hour thereafter: 
Residential - $148.05 (no fractions thereof – rounded up) 
Commercial - $296.08 (no fractions thereof – rounded up) 
10. Board of Building Appeals: 
Residential - $224.68 ($238.16 with surcharge & technology fee included) 
Commercial - $441.54 ($476.87 with surcharge & technology fee included) 
11. Fences over 7’ in height requiring a permit: 
Residential - $148.05 ($156.93 with surcharge & technology fee included) 
Commercial - $189.62($204.79 with surcharge & technology fee included) 
PENALTY FEES 
1. Starting Without a permit – (See Section HC.A105.1.1) – Permit fee + $200% penalty fee 
2. Rescinding a Revoked Permit Fee – (Section HC.A110.6) - $393.54 or original fee whichever is less 
3. Missed Inspection Fee – Failure to schedule a “called-for” inspection before proceeding to cover the work shall result in a Missed Inspection fee: 
Residential - $296.08 ($313.84 with surcharge & technology fee included) 
Commercial - $296.08 ($319.76 with surcharge & technology fee included) 
4. Re—inspection fee – Not ready and Failed Inspections shall result in a Re-inspection Fee: 
Residential - $180.51 ($191.35 with surcharge & technology fee included) 
Commercial - $180.51 ($194.96 with surcharge & technology fee included) 
5. Violations Penalties (Section HC.A113): 
Violations issued under the Code shall be punishable by a fine of not more than $300.00 for each offense as provided in ORC Section 307.37 and 307.99 (C). 
Violations issued for offenses to ORC Chapters 3781 and 3791 shall not be more than $1,000.00. 
Each Day that any such violation or failure continues shall be deemed a separate offense.
